pattern: ADR-016 uses a dedicated GitHub OIDC Terraform deployment service principal.
implication: Retain the identity, never give it Key Vault data-plane read access, and bootstrap only narrowly scoped control-plane role-assignment authority after approval.

pattern: The interactive web identity is already Terraform-managed.
implication: It must receive no Key Vault data-plane role and must not be reused as the worker workload identity.

existingResource.name: placehub-m365-provisioning-development
integrationPoints: Exchange Online application identity only; not automatically the Azure Key Vault workload identity

pattern: The Microsoft 365 provisioning application already exists in the Terraform inventory.
implication: Keep its Exchange identity separate from the still-unselected Azure Key Vault runtime authentication identity.

pattern: Private Azure Blob remote state already exists under ADR-016.
implication: Continue the existing backend and never store PFX, private key, certificate password or secret content in configuration, plan, state or output.

pattern: The controlled bootstrap defines the development workload resource group outside the current Terraform root module.
implication: Reference the confirmed existing group after discovery; never recreate it or assume its live existence from documentation alone.
